messages:
Alex Mercer: Morning — I'm Alex, starting as Product Designer. Hit a snag: Figma invite loads but then shows SSO: account mismatch and won't let me in. Anyone know the quick fix?
Jules Kim: Welcome Alex! :tada: Usually that means it was accepted with a personal account. @Maya can you check SCIM? In the meantime try incognito and accept with your @redwood.com.
Maya Chen: Hi Alex :wave: Sent an SSO invite to alex.mercer@redwood.com. If you still see mismatch, clear figma cookies or DM me the email and I'll temp-add you to the org.
Alex Mercer: New invite worked, thanks — I can open "Design - onboarding kit" and "Product roadmap (canonical)".
Jules Kim: Nice. Roadmap is in Notion -> Product / Roadmap (we keep a snapshot Figma file up top of the workspace). I'll add you to that Notion page.
Alex Mercer: Where's the research sprint checklist? Want to schedule interviews this week.
Nina Rao: Research playbook lives at Product > Playbooks > Research Sprints in Notion. It includes interview guide + consent language. We also link recordings in the Research Archive (GDrive) from that page. I can add you as a viewer.
Alex Mercer: Great. One more: I tried to install the TokenSync plugin and it asked for org admin approval. Who handles plugin whitelisting?
Maya Chen: Plugin approvals go through #eng-security. Post the plugin community URL and a short risk blurb (scopes + external calls). For commonly used plugins we have a pre-approved client id list.
Alex Mercer: Posted the URL and risk note in #eng-security (https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/REDACTED). Thanks.
Jules Kim: Also FYI — our UX->Eng handoff checklist is in Notion -> Product / Handoffs. We add a Handoff page inside each Figma file with the checklist and a small `release_notes.md` snippet. New designers usually do a 10-min walkthrough for their first handoff.
Alex Mercer: Perfect. I'll duplicate the research template and book a sync with the PM and Eng. Who should I ping to pair-run the first interview?
Nina Rao: Ping me or @Samir — happy to join and help with the recruiting screener.
designops-bot: :white_check_mark: Welcome Alex Mercer! Onboarding tasks created: join #design-system, complete security training, request plugin approval, and schedule a 1:1 with a research buddy.
Alex Mercer: Thanks all — will finish the checklist and set up 1:1s. Appreciate the quick responses!
